method.kind: Read-only listening proxies; no auditory judgment or quality score
method.spectrum: Existing inspect(): 8192-point Hann FFT, 50% overlap, summed independent-channel power, unweighted bands, includes fades and silence
method.transientProxy: 10 ms windows; energy increase >5 dB against previous up to 50 ms, current RMS >-45 dBFS, minimum separation 40 ms. Not a perceptual onset detector.
method.activeEnergy: 20 ms windows above -60 dBFS RMS; active RMS excludes lower windows
method.lowBand: Causal fourth-order Butterworth low-pass at 120 Hz (Q 0.541196, 1.306563); applied from beginning before sections
method.mono: Mono=(L+R)/2, reference stereo power=(L²+R²)/2. Relative RMS energy delta includes expected reduction for decorrelated stereo.
method.automation: Manifest-resolved sample frames; absolute values replace static parameters; outgoing linear dB/pan segments, default step, final hold
method.loudness: Reuse native .analysis.json; LUFS and true peak are deliberately not reimplemented
method.limitations: Spectral/energy/waveform evidence is not human audition. Stems are post-track and pre-master; nonlinear master processing prevents exact stem summation.

discontinuityRisk.interpretation: Large adjacent-sample differences may be intentional transients; this proxy cannot certify click audibility.

sourceVoiceActivity.method: Manifest trigger frames and transformed voiceFrames (or source asset frames), capped at master boundary; excludes track effect tails and amplitude envelopes.
